required.quote: All registered optometrists now or hereafter licensed in the State of North Carolina are and shall be required to take annual courses of study in subjects relating to the practice of the profession of optometry

hours_per_period.quote: The length of study shall be prescribed by the Board but shall not exceed 25 hours in any calendar year

period_years.quote: All registered optometrists now or hereafter licensed in the State of North Carolina are and shall be required to take annual courses of study

available.quote: If an applicant for licensure is already licensed in another state in optometry, the North Carolina State Board of Examiners in Optometry shall issue a license to practice optometry to the applicant without examination other than a clinical practicum examination

requirements.value: Applicant must be currently licensed in another state with equivalent or higher standards, actively practiced at least 3 of the past 5 years, be in good standing with no pending disciplinary proceedings, and provide a certificate from the other state's optometry board along with diploma from an accredited optometry college.
requirements.quote: The applicant is currently an active, competent practitioner in good standing, and the applicant has practiced at least three out of the five years immediately preceding his or her application, and the applicant currently holds a valid license in another state, and no disciplinary proceeding or unresolved complaint is pending anywhere at the time a license is to be issued by this State, and the licensure requirements in the other state are equivalent to or higher than those required by this State

disciplinary_grounds.description: Fraud, deceit, or misrepresentation in obtaining or attempting to obtain a license or its renewal
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Has engaged in any act or acts of fraud, deceit or misrepresentation in obtaining or attempting to obtain a license or the renewal thereof

disciplinary_grounds.description: Chronic or persistent use of intoxicants, drugs, or narcotics to the extent it impairs ability to practice
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Is a chronic or persistent user of intoxicants, drugs or narcotics to the extent that the same impairs his ability to practice optometry

disciplinary_grounds.description: Conviction of criminal provisions of the optometry article or plea of guilty or nolo contendere
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Has been convicted of any of the criminal provisions of this Article or has entered a plea of guilty or nolo contendere to any charge or charges arising therefrom

disciplinary_grounds.description: Conviction of or plea to any felony charge or misdemeanor involving moral turpitude
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Has been convicted of or entered a plea of guilty or nolo contendere to any felony charge or to any misdemeanor charge involving moral turpitude

disciplinary_grounds.description: Conviction of or plea to violation of any state or federal narcotic or barbiturate law
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Has been convicted of or entered a plea of guilty or nolo contendere to any charge of violation of any State or federal narcotic or barbiturate law

disciplinary_grounds.description: Violation of any provisions of the article or rules promulgated by the Board, or aiding others to do so
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Has engaged in any act or practice violative of any of the provisions of this Article or violative of any of the rules and regulations promulgated and adopted by the Board, or has aided, abetted or assisted any other person or entity in the violation of the same

disciplinary_grounds.description: Unable to practice with reasonable skill and safety due to substance abuse or physical/mental illness
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Is unable to practice optometry with reasonable skill and safety by reason of abuse of alcohol, drugs, chemicals, or any other type of substance, or by reason of any physical or mental illness, abnormality, or other limiting condition

disciplinary_grounds.description: Permitting another person to use one's name, diploma, or license to illegally practice or fraudulently obtain a license
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Has permitted the use of his name, diploma or license by another person either in the illegal practice of optometry or in attempting to fraudulently obtain a license to practice optometry

disciplinary_grounds.description: Immoral conduct that discredits the optometry profession
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Has engaged in such immoral conduct as to discredit the optometry profession

disciplinary_grounds.description: Obtaining or attempting to obtain any fee through fraud, misrepresentation, or deceit
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Has obtained or collected or attempted to obtain or collect any fee through fraud, misrepresentation, or deceit

disciplinary_grounds.description: Negligence in the practice of optometry
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Has been negligent in the practice of optometry

disciplinary_grounds.description: Employing or aiding an unlicensed person to perform acts that lawfully require a license
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Has employed a person not licensed in this State to do or perform any act of service, or has aided, abetted or assisted any such unlicensed person to do or perform any act or service which under this Article can lawfully be done or performed only by an optometrist licensed in this State

disciplinary_grounds.description: Incompetence in the practice of optometry
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Is incompetent in the practice of optometry

disciplinary_grounds.description: Fraud, deceit, or misrepresentation upon the public or individuals to acquire or retain patients, including false advertising
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Has practiced any fraud, deceit or misrepresentation upon the public or upon any individual in an effort to acquire or retain any patient or patients, including false or misleading advertising

disciplinary_grounds.description: Fraudulent or misleading statements about skill, knowledge, or method of treatment
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Has made fraudulent or misleading statements pertaining to his skill, knowledge, or method of treatment or practice

disciplinary_grounds.description: Fraudulent or misleading acts in the practice of optometry
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Has committed any fraudulent or misleading acts in the practice of optometry

disciplinary_grounds.description: Committing malpractice in the practice of optometry
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Has, in the practice of optometry, committed an act or acts constituting malpractice

disciplinary_grounds.description: Permitting an optometric assistant to perform acts violating the article or board rules
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Has permitted an optometric assistant in his employ or under his supervision to do or perform any act or acts violative to this Article or of the rules and regulations promulgated by the Board

disciplinary_grounds.description: Wrongfully or fraudulently holding oneself out as a specialist in any branch of optometry
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Has wrongfully or fraudulently or falsely held himself out to be or represented himself to be qualified as a specialist in any branch of optometry

disciplinary_grounds.description: Persistently maintaining unsanitary offices, practices, or techniques in the practice of optometry
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Has persistently maintained, in the practice of optometry, unsanitary offices, practices, or techniques

disciplinary_grounds.description: Being a menace to public health by reason of having a serious communicable disease
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Is a menace to the public health by reason of having a serious communicable disease

disciplinary_grounds.description: Engaging in unprofessional conduct as defined by Board rules
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Has engaged in any unprofessional conduct as the same may be from time to time defined by the rules and regulations of the Board

definition_quote.value: The examination of the human eye by any method, other than surgery, to diagnose, to treat, or to refer for consultation or treatment any abnormal condition of the human eye and its adnexa; or the employment of instruments, devices, pharmaceutical agents and procedures, other than surgery, intended for the purposes of investigating, examining, treating, diagnosing or correcting visual defects or abnormal conditions of the human eye or its adnexa; or the prescribing and application of lenses, devices containing lenses, prisms, contact lenses, orthoptics, vision training, pharmaceutical agents, and prosthetic devices to correct, relieve, or treat defects or abnormal conditions of the human eye or its adnexa
definition_quote.quote: The examination of the human eye by any method, other than surgery, to diagnose, to treat, or to refer for consultation or treatment any abnormal condition of the human eye and its adnexa

value: examination of the human eye other than surgery
employment of instruments, devices, pharmaceutical agents and procedures other than surgery
prescribing and application of lenses, contact lenses, prisms, orthoptics, vision training, pharmaceutical agents, and prosthetic devices
methods_authorized.quote: The examination of the human eye by any method, other than surgery, to diagnose, to treat, or to refer for consultation or treatment any abnormal condition of the human eye and its adnexa; or the employment of instruments, devices, pharmaceutical agents and procedures, other than surgery

drug_authority.value: Optometrists certified by the Board may prescribe and use pharmaceutical agents in the practice of optometry after completing educational requirements established by the Board. Legally licensed druggists may fill such prescriptions. Dispensing optometrists may dispense legend or prescription drugs (not controlled substances) to their own patients only.
drug_authority.quote: No optometrist presently licensed in this State shall prescribe and use pharmaceutical agents in the practice of optometry unless and until he (i) has submitted to the Board evidence of satisfactory completion of all educational requirements established by the Board to prescribe and use pharmaceutical agents in the practice of optometry and (ii) has been certified by the Board as educationally qualified to prescribe and use pharmaceutical agents

surgery_prohibited.quote: The examination of the human eye by any method, other than surgery, to diagnose, to treat, or to refer for consultation or treatment any abnormal condition of the human eye and its adnexa

vision_therapy_authorized.quote: The prescribing and application of lenses, devices containing lenses, prisms, contact lenses, orthoptics, vision training, pharmaceutical agents, and prosthetic devices to correct, relieve, or treat defects or abnormal conditions of the human eye or its adnexa

controlled_substance_schedule_restrictio.quote: A registered dispensing optometrist shall not compound medications or dispense controlled substances

oral_pharmaceutical_authority.quote: The prescribing and application of lenses, devices containing lenses, prisms, contact lenses, orthoptics, vision training, pharmaceutical agents, and prosthetic devices to correct, relieve, or treat defects or abnormal conditions of the human eye or its adnexa

pharmaceutical_certification_required.quote: No optometrist presently licensed in this State shall prescribe and use pharmaceutical agents in the practice of optometry unless and until he (i) has submitted to the Board evidence of satisfactory completion of all educational requirements established by the Board to prescribe and use pharmaceutical agents in the practice of optometry and (ii) has been certified by the Board as educationally qualified to prescribe and use pharmaceutical agents

tiered_license_types.quote: As used in this section the term 'licensee' includes licensees, provisional licensees and holders of intern permits, and the term 'license' includes license, provisional license and intern permit

specialty_certification_types.quote: In issuing a certificate of renewal, the Board shall expressly state whether such person, otherwise licensed in the practice of optometry, has been certified to prescribe and use pharmaceutical agents

delegation_to_unlicensed_assistants_auth.quote: Any act or acts performed by an optometric assistant or technician to an optometrist licensed to practice in this State when said act or acts are authorized and permitted by and performed in accordance with rules and regulations promulgated by the Board

contact_lens_prescription_expiration_yea.quote: the expiration date shall be no earlier than 365 days after the examination date

spectacle_prescription_release_required.quote: All persons licensed or registered under this Chapter shall upon request give each patient having received an eye examination a copy of the patient's spectacle prescription, consistent with Federal Trade Commission rules and guidelines

patient_record_retention_years.quote: Prescriptions filled pursuant to this section shall be kept on file by the prescriber and the person filling the prescription for at least 24 months after the prescription is filled
